claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of South Korea's Gangnam District.

findings.quote: Discover classic luxury in the heart of South Korea's Gangnam District at JW Marriott Hotel Seoul.

claims.text: The hotel is directly linked to three lines of Seoul Metro.

findings.quote: is directly linked to three lines of Seoul Metro

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the hotel sits above shopping and the express bus terminal and subway.

findings.quote: Situated above shopping and the express bus terminal/subway

claims.text: Rooms have expansive bedrooms and bathrooms with window-side relaxing sofas.

findings.quote: with expansive bedrooms and bathrooms as well as window-side relaxing sofas

claims.text: Rooms have an in-room Nespresso machine.

findings.quote: Enjoy an in-room Nespresso machine, signature amenities, and sumptuous bedding.

claims.text: The Presidential Penthouse and Ambassador Penthouse sit at the highest levels of the hotel as multi-level suites with city and river views.

findings.quote: The Presidential Penthouse and Ambassador Penthouse located at the highest levels of the hotel are designed as multi-level suites that offer spectacular city and river views.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes high floors provide river views.

findings.quote: high floors provide majestic river views

claims.text: The Spa's signature Wholeness Package begins with a detox session followed by scalp, facial and body treatments.

findings.quote: Most highly recommended signature treatment begins with a detox session, followed by highly effective scalp, facial and body treatments in one attractive package.

claims.text: The Executive Lounge on the 9th floor takes up the whole floor.

findings.quote: Our lounge located on the 9th floor takes up the whole floor

claims.text: Tamayura is a Japanese restaurant offering kaiseki, Edomae sushi omakase and a teppanyaki counter.

findings.quote: Tamayura is our authentic Japanese restaurant offering Kaiseki, a traditional multi-course meal. Enjoy dining in Gangnam, Seoul, with Edomae sushi omakase and a live Western-style teppanyaki counter

claims.text: The Margaux Grill cooks seafood and premium beef on a bespoke wood fire.

findings.quote: The Margaux Grill offers an array of fresh seafood and premium beef cooked on its bespoke wood fire by our grill masters.

claims.text: The pool area has a six-lane indoor pool, a therapy pool, a children's pool, a scuba diving pool, a whirlpool and cabanas.

findings.quote: The pool area features a six lane indoor pool, a therapy pool, a children's pool, a scuba diving pool, a whirlpool and cabanas for relaxing.

claims.text: The Presidential Penthouse is a two-bedroom duplex with floor-to-ceiling windows looking over Seoul, the Han River and Mt. Namsan.

findings.quote: this two-bedroom duplex hotel suite in Gangnam, Seoul, features an elevator as well as floor-to-ceiling glass windows to soak in picturesque views of Seoul, the Han River and Mt. Namsan.

claims.text: Marquis Fitness Club facilities include a jogging track, Pilates room, screen golf zone, squash court and basketball court.

findings.quote: include state-of-the-art professional exercise equipment, 85-meter jogging track, Pilates room, screen golf zone, squash court, basketball court, swimming pool, Jacuzzi, cabanas, sauna and more

claims.text: Guest rooms combine traditional Korean and modern interior notes.

findings.quote: Elegantly combining traditional Korean and modern interior notes

claims.text: JW Garden on the 7th floor is a green space for sunsets and fresh breezes.

findings.quote: Located on the 7th Floor, escape the urban bustle for a moment of calm and sensorial experience amid stunning sunsets, fresh breezes in green tranquility.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the hotel is a few metro stops from attractions and the city center.

findings.quote: travelers who don't mind being a few metro stops from attractions or the city center will find a quality stay

claims.text: The Spa closes every third Thursday of the month.

findings.quote: This Seoul spa closes every third Thursday of the month.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the busy urban location may not suit those seeking a tranquil retreat.
